title: TemporalCoordinate
description: A point on a temporal axis, used as a query time (`at`) or observer time. The core specification models temporal coordinates as RFC 3339 date-time or full-date strings. The MEANING of a coordinate (event time, applicability time, observation time, ...) is defined by the TemporalGroundingProfile, not by the core. Two axes are distinguished conceptually: the query time `at` (the time the caller is asking about) and the optional `observerTime` (the time from whose vantage point admissibility is judged, enabling bitemporal queries).
